You make out a fridge. I mean, just wow! Isn't TextWorld just the best? Empty! What kind of nightmare TextWorld is this? You make out an oven. Classic TextWorld. Empty! What kind of nightmare TextWorld is this? You can see a table. You see a cookbook on the table. Hmmm... what else, what else? You rest your hand against a wall, but you miss the wall and fall onto a counter. But the thing is empty. You hear a noise behind you and spin around, but you can't see anything other than a stove. However, the stove, like an empty stove, has nothing on it.
inventory: You are carrying: a diced parsley, a diced fried red onion, a cilantro and a knife.
